Over the last few years I have been putting my teaching online, and it is now all in one place: course sites, slides, cheat sheets, recordings and short videos. 562 videos so far, all free. A short tour below.
Site: https://nipunbatra.github.io/teaching.html
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@NipunBatra0

It starts with the courses. Every course I have taught at IIT Gandhinagar since 2018 is listed, with each semester's site linked. Machine Learning alone has run eight times.
Site: https://nipunbatra.github.io/teaching.html#courses

This semester it is Deep Learning. Each lecture has a slide handout, a classroom version, a cheat sheet and notebooks. Backprop comes down to one rule: multiply the arriving gradient by the local slope.
Slides: https://nipunbatra.github.io/dl-teaching/slides.html
Course: https://nipunbatra.github.io/dl-2026/

The cheat sheets are two pages each, meant to be printed. There are 86 so far, across five courses.
Site: https://nipunbatra.github.io/teaching.html#cheatsheets

If you prefer full lectures, about 158 are recorded, going back to Operating Systems in 2018. A good one to start with: backprop and autograd from scratch.
Site: https://nipunbatra.github.io/teaching.html#dl-2026
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I0Omc95jFiA

Then the short ones: 270 one-minute videos, each built around one question. Try this before you watch.

Point A is at (3, 0) and point B at (2, 2). Which is closer to (0, 0)?
Site: https://nipunbatra.github.io/ml-in-1-minute.html
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U5O0c7_6ANE

Four one-minute series, each with its own page:
Machine learning (91): https://nipunbatra.github.io/ml-in-1-minute.html
Probability and statistics (53): https://nipunbatra.github.io/psdv-in-1-minute.html
Python (77): https://nipunbatra.github.io/python-in-1-minute.html
Software tools for AI (49): https://nipunbatra.github.io/stai-in-1-minute.html

For more depth, the three-minute lessons take one idea and work a small example: 22 for Deep Learning, 87 for Machine Learning. The attention series starts with "Why attention?"
Site: https://nipunbatra.github.io/dl-in-3-minutes.html
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=61n3ejzg_8A

Seven Ideas in Machine Learning: eight visual episodes, about eight minutes each, on linear algebra, probability, loss functions, numerical computing, sequences and representations.
Site: https://nipunbatra.github.io/teaching.html#seven-ideas-ml
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PBute2l1Xuo

A newer series, How Things Work, explains the systems we use every day. Episode 1: what actually happens between typing a web address and seeing the page?
Site: https://nipunbatra.github.io/teaching.html#how-things-work
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SyEQ-8mO3pY

And a series on Indian scientists. Episode 1 is about Anna Mani and how she measured the atmosphere.
Site: https://nipunbatra.github.io/teaching.html#indian-scientists
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ar_QCBBvqtI

Also: practical tutorials on agentic coding, Python for data science and GitHub Pages. Everything is searchable from one page. If you teach or learn this material, I would like to hear what works for you.
Site: https://nipunbatra.github.io/teaching.html#agentic-ai
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@NipunBatra0
